algorithm: {**A modified version of the Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy (CMA-ES) is used to minimize the Rosenbrock function. The main steps are: 1) Initialize the mean and step-size, 2) Sample candidates from a multivariate normal distribution with the current mean and step-size, 3) Evaluate the fitness of each candidate using the given function, 4) Update the mean and step-size based on the best candidate found so far.**}
